negative_reviews.author: Kimlee Wilson-Miller
negative_reviews.text: The restaurant looks cool and the staff are nice, but I just had the most underwhelming and overly sweet chasu pork yaki soba. I have just double checked the online menu now and this dish was supposed to have vegetables in it too... mine just had a few spring onions and bonito flakes. I feel bad as I recommended this restaurant to my party of friends as I had a decent ramen the month before. But this yaki soba was very poor so I doubt I will be back. Also the waitress brought our bill over before we we finished and it was well before closing time and there were tables free. Atmosphere is nice though.

negative_reviews.author: Anastasia Thompson-vear
negative_reviews.text: Great restaurant, but I noticed the vegan dishes are significantly smaller than the non vegan dishes, despite them being basically the same price.
